meta.title: Publication-Ready Research Content Pack — Phases 1-7
meta.purpose: Single content/data package for implementing researched university, university-course, course-pillar, comparison, specialisation and supporting editorial layers.
meta.important_truth: This pack uses the existing researched datasets as factual source material and only exposes missing values as not published/unverified; it does not invent missing university facts.

publish_only_if: Important factual claims have an official/regulatory source or are explicitly labelled as general guidance.
No conflicting source is silently merged.
The page adds original analysis or decision guidance beyond a source summary.
Long-form duplication between university, course hub and university-course pages is avoided.

research_status_rules.objective: Implement only the content-data foundation. Do not rewrite visible page content yet.
steps: Create a content-research status layer for every university, course family and university-course record.
Add source metadata fields: sourceUrl, sourceType, sourceTitle, verifiedOn, verificationStatus, effectiveSession.
Create explicit statuses: verified_official, verified_regulatory, secondary_reference_only, conflicting, missing, outdated.
Rebuild the university research registry so it contains exactly the current 14 universities.
Do not import the stale university_research entries for SMU, Sharda, OP Jindal, Galgotias, Parul or MAHE into the current 14-university content system.
Mark Online MBA as authored_existing; mark the other eight course families as content_required.
Add a contentReusePolicy at every layer: university-level facts may be inherited only when relevant; long-form paragraphs must not be duplicated into university-course pages.
Do not fabricate missing fields. Render 'Not published by the university' or equivalent only after the research status confirms the official source was checked.
Do not change routes, UI, SEO URLs, comparison pages or existing good content in this phase.
Create a QA report that lists remaining missing fields after the data-status layer is implemented.

current_gaps.issue: The 14-university master dataset is only partially verified and has large empty field groups.
current_gaps.evidence: All 14 records are marked partial_verification; most have empty admission details, scholarship arrays, and several recognition/basic-information fields.
current_gaps.action: Do not publish these empty fields as generic prose. Research and populate them from current official sources in Phase 2.

current_gaps.issue: university-course-master-content.json contains a stale/mismatched university_research universe.
current_gaps.evidence: Current university master has Amity, MUJ, VGU, LPU, DU SOL, IGNOU, NMIMS, CU, DPU, NSOU, KSOU, Subharti, BAOU and JAIN. The research object instead includes SMU, Sharda, OP Jindal, Galgotias, Parul and MAHE and omits several current universities.
current_gaps.action: Do not merge this research object into current university pages. Rebuild the research registry against the current 14-university master list.

current_gaps.issue: Only Online MBA is fully authored at the reusable course-family level.
current_gaps.evidence: course-pages/index.ts contains authored content only for online-mba; other families fall back to defaultCourseContent().
current_gaps.action: Create authored research/content files for Online MCA, BBA, BCA, B.Com, BA, MA, M.Sc and M.Com before treating those course hubs as content-complete.

current_gaps.issue: Generic fallback course content contains generic curriculum, exam and learning statements that can read as if they apply to every university.
current_gaps.action: Replace generic factual-looking statements with course-level explanatory content plus university-specific verified facts; keep universal statements clearly labelled as general guidance.

current_gaps.issue: Blog/news library is very small: only 9 long-form post-content objects exist.
current_gaps.action: Keep the existing 9; build a research-backed editorial backlog rather than mass-generating thin variants.

current_gaps.issue: The current data model has university-level scholarship arrays empty even though separate research files contain scholarship information.
current_gaps.action: Create one authoritative scholarship dataset with programme-specific overrides and source/verification metadata.

current_gaps.issue: Some current source records use secondary/aggregator sources for facts that should be official.
current_gaps.action: Use official university/regulator documents first; secondary sources may identify gaps but must not become the authority for fees, eligibility, scholarships, curriculum or exam rules.

global.missing_value_label: Not published by the university / manually researched from the official website
global.last_verified_basis: The underlying research datasets are dated 2026-08-10; current web checks on 2026-08-13 were used to sanity-check selected live official pages, including DU SOL, NMIMS, VGU, Online Manipal, JAIN, Amity and LPU.

validation.claim: DU SOL lists its 2026-27 UG and PG programmes and admissions as live.
DU SOL 2026-27 UG prospectus publishes fee structure including the listed first-year total for relevant programmes.
NMIMS Online publishes current MBA fee options and 2026 admission dates.
VGU publishes a 2026-27 fee structure with programme-specific MBA/BBA/BCA/MCA entries.
Online Manipal currently lists programme duration and fees for multiple online degrees.
JAIN Online currently lists its programme portfolio, specialisations and published total fees.
Amity Online currently lists its online degree programme catalogue.
NMIMS Online MBA page specifies current eligibility and fee schedule.

content_strategy.purpose: Build supporting articles/guides around real search intent and connect them into the course, specialisation, university-course and comparison architecture.
content_types: News/update where there is a genuinely time-sensitive event
article_structure: Common mistakes or things to verify

article_seo.title_rule: Write for the actual question, not keyword stuffing.
article_seo.meta: Accurately describe the article; no clickbait.
article_seo.canonical: Self-canonical unless the article is intentionally consolidated.
schema: FAQPage only when visible FAQs genuinely exist
article_seo.images: Use descriptive alt text; do not use keyword-stuffed alt attributes.
article_seo.freshness: Update facts when they change; do not change dates simply to look fresh.

source_hierarchy: Competitor pages only for gap analysis and search-intent discovery, never as factual authority
content_research_workflow: Identify what existing website content already covers.
Research competing pages only to discover gaps and structure.
Add internal links to the appropriate pillar/specialisation/university-course/comparison page.
Check factual claims and source freshness.

anti_cannibalization_matrix.rule: If two pages answer essentially the same question, consolidate or clearly differentiate them before publishing.

internal_linking_rules: Every article should have a clear parent topic.
Link upward to the relevant course pillar.
Link sideways to a relevant specialisation or comparison page when useful.
Link downward to exact university-course pages only when the article discusses that university/programme.
Avoid forcing the same anchor text into every article.
Do not build huge footer link farms.
Use contextual links where the user would naturally want the next answer.

create_news_only_when: There is a real current event, official admission update, result, regulatory update or meaningful university announcement.
do_not: Create daily low-value news just for freshness.
Create multiple pages from the same announcement.
